About Clutch

Building sites for clients? Get all 70 paid Plainware templates for $299 with the Agency License, 91% off the $3,280 they cost one by one.

Clutch is a driving school website template that looks like the road it teaches on: asphalt, lane-yellow paint and wide poster type. It answers what parents and new drivers ask first: how long it takes, what it costs and who sits in the passenger seat.

Remix not working? Use this link.

See every Plainware template

Made for driving schools, driving academies and driving instructors: driver education and drivers ed, driving lessons and driving courses, road test and driving test prep, defensive driving and safety courses, and traffic school.

Also a fit for learner driver and teen driver programs, adult driving lessons, road safety courses and any driver training business that takes lesson booking requests online and helps new drivers earn a driver's license or driving license.

What makes Clutch different

Route to a license: five stops from learner license to road test on a dashed center line beside a pinned intro

44 hours, drawn: a lane-yellow field where every behind-the-wheel hour is a square, instructor hours and parent hours apart

Prices as road signs: teen and adult packages on two sign faces, plus full price boards on the Pricing page

Test route ticker: practice streets with the skill each one teaches

Road test page: checklists, the eight scored skills, the day-of timeline and common mistakes on the driving test

Pages included (24 URLs)

Home, Courses, Pricing, Instructors, Road test, For parents, Book, Blog, Contact

6 course pages and 5 blog posts (CMS)

404, Privacy, Terms, Legal

What's included

Desktop, tablet and phone layouts on every page

Native Framer lesson booking form

A setup guide page: how to edit prices, courses, instructors, colors and fonts

Free updates

Not a Framer user? We set it up for you: $299 fixed, template included, ready in 3 business days.
